note: Implementation and controlled tests do not establish connected-service verification. User AGENTS pins new documents to PDC 1; existing PDC 2 documents will be read without conversion.
remaining_release_gates: No live provider, paid voice, Slack account, OpenBot/Docker, or production oxibrain verification.
Backup is individually consistent per SQLite database, not atomic across databases; external PDC spaces/assets are referenced and not copied.
Normalized durable rows reduce database rewrites; commit encoding and snapshot cloning still scale with retained history.
Separate-host federation, multi-user authentication, A2A interoperability, signed releases and portable dependency bundles remain outside this verified local unit.
Three pre-existing SDK doctests are ignored.
